independent_review.failure_attribution: Postprocessing schema mismatch: decoder raw_manifest rows have stage/shape/bytes/sha256 but no file; the new adapter indexes row['file'] unconditionally. Sixteen decoder proofs are discarded as KeyError("file"), causing eight further on/off failures.
independent_review.scope: Initial failed cache-audit journal. Retained command logs support the adapter failure attribution and bounded benchmark observations; complete raw manifest/on-off qualification awaits hosted reanalysis.
limits: The raw ZIP remains remote. Its service digest and metadata were checked, but its raw members, byte hashes, shapes, count and on/off equality are not independently verified by this small-report review.
All successful command exits and matching scalar observations do not waive missing raw qualification. Preserve this rejected producer unchanged and record hosted reanalysis separately.

Paired timings cover three alternating pairs on one nine-token image and one CPU session. Cold median on/off is about0.97266 and warm about0.99203 with a warm pair slower; these observations do not establish a robust speed win.
Fresh-process peak RSS includes model loading, conversion/graph workspace and recognition; it is not retained-cache bytes alone. Two-context initialization is measured jointly.
The enabled default-off cache still requires the separate quality receipt and positive hosted raw reanalysis. No default, model publication, runtime release or app upgrade follows.
